summary: Under normal market circumstances, seeks to achieve its objective by (1) investing at least 80% of its net assets in equity investments of companies that, at the time of investment, are included in the Nasdaq-100® Index and/or options, or futures, ETFs or options on ETFs that seek to replicate the returns of the index, and (2) investing in options strategies that seek to generate current income. The fund is non-diversified.
